suiteFeedDecision.newDecisivelyBeatsOldExplanation: Yes. Round three decisively beats the old engine across every rubric dimension and now produces five senior-art-direction professional candidates. This is not autonomous-release approval: seven assets remain below 145, the relay still falls short of full textless communication, and every current hash still requires agreement from the other mandated critics.

observations: The feed alternates macro material, dark architecture, human photography, editorial framing, Arabic flat systems, and English evidence objects without repeating one fixed layout.
Green, mineral white, dark stone, and one charged-state behavior establish continuity while focal geometry and density vary materially from tile to tile.
The flat-vector subgroup shares rail-and-node language, but the feed avoids template monotony because those tiles are separated by photography, object, and editorial systems.
Five tiles plausibly reach professional art-direction quality, while 03, 04, 06, 08, 09, 10, and 11 still keep the overall suite from being presented as uniformly professional.
The sequence now moves cleanly from locating the decision, through defining inputs and outputs, to an unmistakable human stop.
The round-two typography hard failure on slide 10 is gone, and all three slides remain legible in the reviewed mobile sequence.
The rail vocabulary is coherent but still conventionally diagrammatic; slides 09 and 11 are stronger than the denser middle frame, and none individually reaches 145 in this review.
05 still reads as many scattered status strands becoming one owned output and remains the successful original mechanism.
07 now reads as two materially different records physically interlocked by one provenance rivet, not as premium stationery.
12 now reads as an ordered core sample extracted from dense strata, not as a network, database, funnel, or decorative stack.
03 clearly reads as three discrete controlled stations rather than a conveyor, but the captured state does not yet make the release-to-verification-to-stop order fully self-evident without copy.

preciseRevisionPriorities: Preserve the exact hashes of 01, 02, 05, 07, and 12 as professional candidates for cross-critic review; do not alter them before the other roles score the same pixels.
Give 03 one bounded state-change revision that shows active release, verified grip, and closed receiving stop without adding labels or arrows.
Deepen 06 beyond generic synthesis rails and remove or justify its semantically idle upper-left bar.
Replace conventional terminal or rail furniture in 04, 09, 10, and 11 only if those assets are required to clear 145; preserve their current Arabic copy and hierarchy.
Treat 08 as a strong series identity frame rather than claiming it proves a standalone conceptual post.

overallVerdict.summary: Round three is the first benchmark generation with a credible professional upper tier: 01, 02, 05, 07, and 12 score 145–147 from senior art direction, all exact current hashes are free of hard failures, 07 and 12 now pass their textless restart tests, and the feed is coherent without being one template. The suite is not uniformly professional, 03 remains only partially self-explanatory without copy, and production cannot resume until the graphic-design, social-performance, and Arabic reviews independently clear the same applicable hashes.
overallVerdict.releasePosition: No production or golden-set release is authorized by this single-role review. Preserve the five candidate hashes and complete the required independent critique sets.
